Straight answer: at home power rates the sats usually come to less than the electricity, so don't buy it as an income machine.

What you're buying is a real draw at a full 3.125 BTC block every ten minutes, for years, and you keep the machine after every draw — plus steady sats to your own wallet meanwhile. At under 12¢ the 40T is our best value per TH at $799.
